378	// extractInlineRepoFilters extracts only repo: prefixed filters from a query
379	// string, returning the remaining query text and the list of repo values.
380	// Unlike search.ParseSearchInput, this does NOT consume author:, date:, or
381	// branch: tokens — those are checkpoint-search-only and should be treated as
382	// literal text in code search queries.
383	func extractInlineRepoFilters(query string) (remaining string, repos []string) {
384		var kept []string
385		for _, part := range strings.Fields(query) {
386			if strings.HasPrefix(part, "repo:") {
387				// Split comma-separated values (repo:a,b → [a, b]), matching
388				// checkpoint search's parseListFilter behavior. Trim quotes so
389				// repo:"gh/owner/repo" works like the unquoted form.
390				for _, v := range strings.Split(part[5:], ",") {
391					v = strings.Trim(v, `"'`)
392					if v != "" {
393						repos = append(repos, v)
394					}
395				}
396			} else {
397				kept = append(kept, part)
398			}
399		}
400		return strings.Join(kept, " "), repos
401	}

498	// searchAllCells fans out code search across all cells that host the user's
499	// repos, using the shared cell-routing foundation (cell_fanout.go):
500	//  1. List repos from the control plane (entire-core) to discover cells
501	//  2. Resolve repo slug filters to ULIDs
502	//  3. Group by cell and resolve baseURLs via the shared helpers
503	//  4. Fan out via fanOutCells with per-cell codesearch.Search calls
504	//  5. Merge results (sorted by score, capped to limit)
505	func searchAllCells(ctx context.Context, opts codeSearchOpts) (*codesearch.SearchResponse, error) {
506		// Step 1: Get repos index from the control plane.
507		// coreapi.Client satisfies cellCoreClient (for resolveCellBaseURLs)
508		// and also provides ListRepos (which cellCoreClient doesn't expose).
509		coreClient, err := coreapi.New()
510		if err != nil {
511			if errors.Is(err, auth.ErrNotLoggedIn) {
512				return nil, loginHintErr(err)
513			}
514			return nil, fmt.Errorf("resolving control-plane client: %w", err)
515		}
516	
517		reposCtx, reposCancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 10*time.Second)
518		defer reposCancel()
519	
520		repoIndex, err := coreClient.ListRepos(reposCtx, coreapi.ListReposParams{})
521		if err != nil {
522			return nil, fmt.Errorf("listing repos for cell discovery: %w", err)
523		}
524	
525		if repoIndex.Truncated {
526			logging.Warn(ctx, "repo index truncated; code search results may be incomplete")
527		}
528	
529		// Step 2: Resolve repo slug filters to ULIDs and narrow to matching cells.
530		indexRepos := repoIndex.Repos
531		if len(opts.repoFilters) > 0 {
532			resolved, filtered := resolveRepoFilters(opts.repoFilters, repoIndex.Repos)
533			if len(resolved) == 0 {
534				hint := ""
535				if repoIndex.Truncated {
536					hint = " (repo index was truncated — the repo may exist but was not included)"
537				}
538				return nil, fmt.Errorf("no matching repositories found for filter %q%s", opts.repoFilters, hint)
539			}
540			opts.resolvedRepoIDs = resolved
541			indexRepos = filtered
542		}
543	
544		// Step 3: Group repos by cell and resolve baseURLs via shared helpers.
545		cells := groupReposByCell(indexRepos)
546		if len(cells) == 0 {
547			return &codesearch.SearchResponse{}, nil
548		}
549		resolveCellBaseURLs(ctx, coreClient, cells)
550	
551		// Step 4: Fan out via the shared fanOutCells helper.
552		// Each cell gets the full limit for single-cell, or 2x for multi-cell so
553		// the merge sees enough candidates from every region for proper global
554		// ranking. mergeSearchResults applies the final cap.
555		perCellLimit := opts.limit
556		if len(cells) > 1 && perCellLimit > 0 {
557			perCellLimit *= 2
558		}
559		results, err := fanOutCells(ctx, opts.insecureHTTP, codeSearchCellTimeout, cells, func(ctx context.Context, group cellGroup, client *api.Client) (*codesearch.SearchResponse, error) {
560			var repoIDs []string
561			if len(opts.resolvedRepoIDs) > 0 {
562				repoIDs = group.repoIDs
563			}
564			req := codesearch.SearchRequest{
565				Query:         opts.query,
566				Repos:         repoIDs,
567				CaseSensitive: opts.caseSensitive,
568			}
569			if perCellLimit > 0 {
570				req.MaxResults = perCellLimit
571			}
572			return codesearch.Search(ctx, client, req)
573		})
574		if err != nil {
575			if errors.Is(err, auth.ErrNotLoggedIn) {
576				return nil, loginHintErr(err)
577			}
578			return nil, fmt.Errorf("code search: %w", err)
579		}
580	
581		return mergeSearchResults(ctx, opts.limit, results)
582	}

584	// resolveRepoFilters matches user-provided filters against the repo index,
585	// returning the ULID list for peregrine and the subset of index entries whose
586	// repos matched (for cell grouping).
587	//
588	// Matching mirrors the BFF (code-search.ts lines 315-319):
589	//
590	//	slug = filter starts with "gh/" ? strip prefix : filter unchanged
591	//	match = id === filter || full_name === slug || full_name === filter
592	//
593	// Accepted filter formats:
594	//   - ULID            — matched directly on repo ID (raw filter)
595	//   - gh/owner/repo   — GitHub repo, stripped to owner/repo for FullName match
596	//   - owner/repo      — bare slug, matched on FullName directly
597	func resolveRepoFilters(filters []string, repos []coreapi.RepoIndexEntry) (repoIDs []string, matched []coreapi.RepoIndexEntry) {
598		byName := make(map[string]coreapi.RepoIndexEntry, len(repos))
599		byID := make(map[string]coreapi.RepoIndexEntry, len(repos))
600		for _, r := range repos {
601			byName[strings.ToLower(r.FullName)] = r
602			byID[r.ID] = r
603		}
604		seen := make(map[string]bool) // dedup by ID
605		for _, f := range filters {
606			// BFF only strips gh/ prefix; other prefixes are left as-is.
607			slug := f
608			if strings.HasPrefix(f, "gh/") {
609				slug = f[3:]
610			}
611	
612			// Match order mirrors the BFF: id === filter || full_name === slug || full_name === filter
613			// FullName comparison is case-insensitive so casing differences between
614			// the git remote (e.g. entireio/CLI) and the repo index (entireio/cli)
615			// don't cause a "no matching repositories found" failure.
616			var r coreapi.RepoIndexEntry
617			var ok bool
618			if r, ok = byID[f]; !ok {
619				if r, ok = byName[strings.ToLower(slug)]; !ok {
620					r, ok = byName[strings.ToLower(f)]
621				}
622			}
623			if ok && !seen[r.ID] {
624				repoIDs = append(repoIDs, r.ID)
625				matched = append(matched, r)
626				seen[r.ID] = true
627			}
628		}
629		return repoIDs, matched
630	}

632	// mergeSearchResults merges responses from multiple cells into one, combining
633	// results, stats, and repo_stats. Results are sorted by Score (descending) for
634	// global relevance ranking and truncated to limit. Individual cell errors are
635	// logged and skipped, but if ALL cells fail the error is surfaced.
636	func mergeSearchResults(ctx context.Context, limit int, results []cellCallResult[*codesearch.SearchResponse]) (*codesearch.SearchResponse, error) {
637		merged := &codesearch.SearchResponse{}
638		var lastErr error
639		successCount := 0
640		for _, r := range results {
641			if r.err != nil {
642				lastErr = r.err
643				continue
644			}
645			if r.value == nil {
646				continue
647			}
648			successCount++
649			merged.Results = append(merged.Results, r.value.Results...)
650			merged.RepoStats = append(merged.RepoStats, r.value.RepoStats...)
651			merged.Stats.TotalMatches += r.value.Stats.TotalMatches
652			merged.Stats.TotalFiles += r.value.Stats.TotalFiles
653			merged.Stats.ReposSearched += r.value.Stats.ReposSearched
654			if r.value.Stats.DurationMs > merged.Stats.DurationMs {
655				merged.Stats.DurationMs = r.value.Stats.DurationMs // wall-clock = slowest cell
656			}
657			if merged.Query == "" {
658				merged.Query = r.value.Query
659			}
660		}
661	
662		if successCount == 0 && lastErr != nil {
663			return nil, fmt.Errorf("code search failed: %w", lastErr)
664		}
665	
666		// Track partial failures so consumers (especially --json) can see them.
667		var failedJurisdictions []string
668		for _, r := range results {
669			if r.err == nil {
670				continue
671			}
672			failedJurisdictions = append(failedJurisdictions, r.group.label())
673		}
674		if len(failedJurisdictions) > 0 {
675			logging.Warn(ctx, "code search partial failure; results may be incomplete",
676				"succeeded", successCount,
677				"total", len(results),
678				"failed_cells", failedJurisdictions)
679		}
680	
681		// Sort by score descending so results are globally ranked by relevance,
682		// not grouped by whichever cell returned first. Stable sort with a
683		// tiebreaker keeps --json output deterministic across runs.
684		sort.SliceStable(merged.Results, func(i, j int) bool {
685			a, b := merged.Results[i], merged.Results[j]
686			if a.Score != b.Score {
687				return a.Score > b.Score
688			}
689			if a.Repo != b.Repo {
690				return a.Repo < b.Repo
691			}
692			if a.Path != b.Path {
693				return a.Path < b.Path
694			}
695			return a.Line < b.Line
696		})
697	
698		// Deduplicate results that may appear from overlapping cells (e.g. a repo
699		// with empty jurisdiction searched via both home and explicit cell).
700		seen := make(map[string]bool, len(merged.Results))
701		deduped := merged.Results[:0]
702		for _, r := range merged.Results {

715		// searched in both cells) — not additional matches. Keep one representative
716		// entry per repo (the max of each count; mirror copies are identical, max
717		// only guards against minor per-cell skew) instead of summing, and record
718		// the duplicated portion so the aggregate stats can drop the double-count.
